cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let my bicycle into the cafe just this once. I taught you to run this counter; you can judge a wet customer without looking at the sign.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're finally making distinctions. Write 'bicycles admitted in rain' in the handover book; that's a useful decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Jo's on tomorrow. She'll put it straight outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Show her your entry before you go. Remember how I made you explain a handover? Tell her you've already tried this, then I won't have to start again with my bicycle.
